title: Mini Parser
description: Deserialize a nested list string into a NestedInteger structure.
pseudocode:
1. stack = []
2. for char in s:
3.   if char == '[': stack.push(NestedInteger())
4.   else if char == ',' : continue
5.   else if char == ']': 
6.     curr = stack.pop()
7.     if stack: stack.top().add(curr)
8.     else: return curr
9.   else: parse number and add to stack.top()

steps.note: Initialize stack with empty list for '['
Parse 123 and add to top list
Encountered '[', push new list onto stack
Parse 456 and add to top list
Encountered '[', push new list onto stack
Parse 789 and add to top list
